summary: You can reinvent yourself when you choose to. Real transformative power is available to you, switched on the moment you reach for it. It won't push itself on you.
body: You can reinvent yourself when you choose to. Real transformative power is available to you, switched on the moment you reach for it. It won't push itself on you. Left unused, you live at a normal setting and wonder where the depth went. But when you turn toward it, you can shed an old version of yourself completely and rebuild. The opening rewards the willing. Reach for the power and you stop being at the mercy of your own patterns.
gift: At your best: able to remake yourself on purpose when you choose to.
shadow: The trap: living at the normal setting and leaving the deeper power untapped.
integration: Let identity and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
do: Reach for the power on purpose
Shed the old version when it's time
Use the depth before a crisis forces it
dont: Wait for life to corner you
